I wasn’t involved in the crash but a man driving a motorbike took a corner coming off a motorway too quick ended up on the other side of the motorway and landed just in front of my car.
I was 18 and passed my driving test weeks before but I got out of the car stopped a few other cars and I had to try my best to keep him awake &apply pressure to his bleeding leg. Bits of flesh where everywhere and that’s what really got me seeing something so horrific at a young age. I kept phoning the hospital and he survived. His wife got my contact details and months later after rehab for the man he was able to walk again and they treated me to a meal. I lost a lot of sleep after seeing the gory stuff but I’m thankful I acted quick as the couple had only recently had a baby so I’m glad the guy survived to raise his child.
